description: This file contains template classes, enums, and functions for safe numeric conversions, range checking, and type range relation analysis, primarily used for ensuring safe type casting between numeric types in the Chromium project.

classes.name: MaxExponent
classes.description: Template struct to compute the maximum exponent for a numeric type, considering whether the type is IEC559 compliant or not.

classes.name: NarrowingRange
classes.description: Template struct to determine the maximum and minimum values for safe narrowing conversions from floating-point to integer types.

methods.name: GetRangeConstraint
methods.description: Creates a RangeConstraint based on boolean upper and lower bound checks.

methods.name: DstRangeRelationToSrcRange
methods.description: Determines the relation of the destination type's range to the source type's range for a given value, used for safe conversions.
